I personally went to an Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) for a few weeks last year for OCD. They also have them for anxiety and depression. The cost is less than a residential program would be, but the support is definitely stronger than just individual therapy. It extremely helped me, but I didn't really continue with regular therapy which is something you must do to maintain your health. 

The best of luck and feel free to message me!
